```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

corn_data <- corn_all %>%
  mutate(
    N_Treatment = as.factor(N_Treatment),
    `Study/Field` = as.factor(`Study/Field`),
    Year = as.factor(Year),
    Stage = as.factor(Stage),
    ID = as.factor(ID)
  )
```

```{r}
corn_data %>%
  distinct(
    `Study/Field`,
    Year,
    Stage,
    DAP,
    N_Treatment
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    `Study/Field`,
    Year,
    DAP
  )
```

```{r}
corn_data %>%
  group_by(
    `Study/Field`,
    Year,
    Stage,
    DAP,
    N_Treatment
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    n_NNI = sum(!is.na(NNI)),
    n_PNC = sum(!is.na(`PNC_g/kg`)),
    n_PNU = sum(!is.na(`PNU_kg/ha`)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
corn_data <- corn_data %>%
  mutate(
    Experiment = interaction(
      `Study/Field`,
      Year,
      drop = TRUE
    ),
    Plot_ID = interaction(
      `Study/Field`,
      Year,
      ID,
      drop = TRUE
    )
  )
```

```{r}
corn_data %>%
  group_by(
    Experiment,
    Stage
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    Total = n(),
    NNI = sum(!is.na(NNI)),
    PNC = sum(!is.na(`PNC_g/kg`)),
    PNU = sum(!is.na(`PNU_kg/ha`)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
corn_data <- corn_data %>%
  mutate(
    Complete_Spectra = if_all(
      starts_with("Band_"),
      ~ !is.na(.x)
    ),
    Complete_Nitrogen = if_all(
      c(
        NNI,
        `PNC_g/kg`,
        `PNU_kg/ha`
      ),
      ~ !is.na(.x)
    )
  )
```

```{r}
df_nitrogen <- corn_data %>%
  select(
    Experiment,
    Stage,
    DAP,
    N_Treatment,
    ID,
    NNI,
    `PNC_g/kg`,
    `PNU_kg/ha`
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      NNI,
      `PNC_g/kg`,
      `PNU_kg/ha`
    ),
    names_to = "Parameter",
    values_to = "Value"
  )
```

```{r}
experiment_1 <- levels(corn_data$Experiment)[1]

df_nitrogen %>%
  filter(Experiment == experiment_1) %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = N_Treatment,
    y = Value,
    fill = N_Treatment
  )) +
  geom_boxplot(
    alpha = 0.7,
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.12,
    alpha = 0.4,
    size = 1.2
  ) +
  facet_grid(
    Parameter ~ Stage,
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste(
      "Corn Nitrogen Status:",
      experiment_1
    ),
    x = "Nitrogen Treatment",
    y = "Measured Value"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```

```{r}
corn_spectral <- corn_data %>%
  select(
    Experiment,
    Plot_ID,
    N_Treatment,
    Year,
    Stage,
    Date,
    DAP,
    ID,
    NNI,
    `PNC_g/kg`,
    `PNU_kg/ha`,
    Band_5:Band_293
  )
```

```{r}
corn_spectral_long <- corn_spectral %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("Band_"),
    names_to = "Band",
    values_to = "Reflectance"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Band_Number = as.numeric(
      sub("Band_", "", Band)
    )
  )
```

```{r}
corn_spectral_long %>%
  filter(
    Experiment == experiment_1
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = Band_Number,
    y = Reflectance,
    group = interaction(Plot_ID, Date),
    color = N_Treatment
  )) +
  geom_line(
    alpha = 0.5,
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste(
      "Corn Hyperspectral Reflectance:",
      experiment_1
    ),
    x = "Hyperspectral Band",
    y = "Reflectance",
    color = "N Treatment"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13)
```
```{r}
corn_spectral_long %>%

    Experiment == experiment_2
  ) %>%
```

```{r}
corn_spectral_mean <- corn_spectral_long %>%
  group_by(
    Experiment,
    Stage,
    DAP,
    N_Treatment,
    Band_Number
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Reflectance = mean(
      Reflectance,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    SD_Reflectance = sd(
      Reflectance,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    n = sum(!is.na(Reflectance)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
corn_spectral_mean %>%
  filter(
    Experiment == experiment_1
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = Band_Number,
    y = Mean_Reflectance,
    color = N_Treatment
  )) +
  geom_line(
    linewidth = 1.1
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ Stage
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste(
      "Mean Hyperspectral Reflectance:",
      experiment_1
    ),
    x = "Hyperspectral Band",
    y = "Mean Reflectance",
    color = "N Treatment"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    strip.text = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    ),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r}
exp_pca <- experiment_1
stage_pca <- "R1"
```

```{r}
pca_data <- corn_data %>%
  filter(
    Experiment == exp_pca,
    Stage == stage_pca
  )
```

```{r}
band_cols <- names(corn_data) %>%
  .[grepl("^Band_", .)] 
```

```{r}
band_cols <- names(corn_data) %>%
  .[grepl("^Band_", .)] 

band_cols <- band_cols[5:293]
```

```{r}
complete_idx <- complete.cases(
  pca_data[, band_cols]
)
```

```{r}
pca_meta <- pca_data %>%
  filter(complete_idx) %>%
  select(
    Plot_ID,
    N_Treatment,
    Experiment,
    Stage,
    DAP,
    NNI,
    `PNC_g/kg`,
    `PNU_kg/ha`
  )
```

```{r}
pca_spectra <- pca_data %>%
  filter(complete_idx) %>%
  select(all_of(band_cols))
```

```{r}
pca_model <- prcomp(
  pca_spectra,
  center = TRUE,
  scale. = TRUE
)

summary(pca_model)
```

```{r}
pca_var <- data.frame(
  PC = paste0(
    "PC",
    1:length(pca_model$sdev)
  ),
  Variance = (pca_model$sdev^2) /
    sum(pca_model$sdev^2),
  Cumulative = cumsum(
    (pca_model$sdev^2) /
    sum(pca_model$sdev^2)
  )
)

head(pca_var, 10)
```

```{r}
ggplot(
  pca_var[1:15, ],
  aes(
    x = reorder(PC, seq_along(PC)),
    y = Variance
  )
) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_line(
    aes(group = 1)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste(
      "Scree Plot:",
      exp_pca,
      "-",
      stage_pca
    ),
    x = "Principal Component",
    y = "Proportion of Variance"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13)
```
```{r}
pca_scores <- as.data.frame(
  pca_model$x
)

pca_scores <- bind_cols(
  pca_meta,
  pca_scores
)

head(pca_scores)
```

```{r}
ggplot(
  pca_scores,
  aes(
    x = PC1,
    y = PC2,
    color = N_Treatment
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    size = 3,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste(
      "PCA Scores:",
      exp_pca,
      "-",
      stage_pca
    ),
    x = "PC1",
    y = "PC2",
    color = "N Treatment"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13)
```

```{r}
ggplot(
  pca_scores,
  aes(
    x = PC1,
    y = PC2,
    color = N_Treatment,
    label = Plot_ID
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    size = 3,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_text(
    size = 3,
    vjust = -0.7
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste(
      "PCA Scores:",
      exp_pca,
      "-",
      stage_pca
    ),
    x = "PC1",
    y = "PC2",
    color = "N Treatment"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13)
```

```{r}
pca_loadings <- as.data.frame(
  pca_model$rotation
)

pca_loadings$Band <- rownames(
  pca_loadings
)

pca_loadings$Band_Number <- as.numeric(
  sub(
    "Band_",
    "",
    pca_loadings$Band
  )
)

head(pca_loadings)
```

```{r}
ggplot(
  pca_loadings,
  aes(
    x = Band_Number,
    y = PC1
  )
) +
  geom_line(
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste(
      "PC1 Loadings:",
      exp_pca,
      "-",
      stage_pca
    ),
    x = "Band Number",
    y = "Loading"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13)
```
```{r}
ggplot(
  pca_loadings,
  aes(
    x = Band_Number,
    y = PC2
  )
) +
  geom_line(
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste(

    ),

```

```{r}
head(top_pc1, 15)
```

```{r}
pca_cor <- pca_scores %>%
  select(
    PC1,
    PC2,
    PC3,
    NNI,
    `PNC_g/kg`,
    `PNU_kg/ha`
  ) %>%
  cor(
    use = "pairwise.complete.obs",
    method = "pearson"
  )

round(pca_cor, 2)
```
```{r}
pca_scores %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      NNI,
      `PNC_g/kg`,
      `PNU_kg/ha`
    ),
    names_to = "Parameter",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = PC1,
    y = Value,
    color = N_Treatment
  )) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    se = FALSE,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ Parameter,
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Relationship Between PC1 and Nitrogen Status",
    x = "PC1 Score",
    y = "Nitrogen Parameter"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13)
```
